main_measure.name: mean 10-bar forward return in long blocks minus mean over all blocks
main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; excess <= 0 rejects (t <= -2 means reversal)

supporting_check.name: long-block hit rate minus all-block hit rate (slope of return on forecast as second view)

decided_by: Inconclusive: excess > 0 but confirm rule not met (t below 2; hit rate not above unconditional; excess positive in only 0 windows (need 4)).
reading: Blocks start at rows 0,10,20,... of each window with a full 10-bar return inside it, 'all blocks' includes long ones and the t is Welch's between long and all blocks, per-window excess uses that window's own all-block mean, the slope is fit over all blocks, and 'carried by a single window' means the pooled excess is <= 0 once any one window is left out.
